title: 🚨 NWS Moderate: Dense Fog Advisory
summary:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Petersburg Borough.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Hazardous travel conditions due to low visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Fog will gradually lift and dissipate
through the early afternoon.
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
